objective: Identify a second efficient decision rule for disjoint corridors between two repeated middle names. Determine its exact conditions, construct witnesses and cover transfer pitfalls for visible switches.
status: Proved: On disjoint paths between opposite pinned repeated middles, ordinary satisfiability reduces exactly to the CNF of ways to break each path. With at most two normalized clause occurrences per pad, a linear orientation algorithm returns a witness; the minimal contradictory clause families are the unmarked tree components.
title: Grouping short routes by the padding variables they share
